page.overview:
Who is Gerald Kawaoki?

Gerald Kawaoki was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century. He was a flag officer with the rank of admiral in 2364.

On stardate 41375.3, he sent an order about fiscal cutbacks to Captain of the . The admiral requested the captain to send acknowledgement of the receipt of this order through subspace com net security mode 045, code 100 alpha. (, okudagram)
